deed: חברת סייקי פיתחה משאף ראשון בעולם למינון מדויק של קנאביס רפואי
title: Israel's Syqe developed an inhaler that delivers medical cannabis in a precise dose, and it was tested at Rambam

trailer.text: Syqe Medical is an Israeli company whose development center is in Jaffa and whose inhaler is manufactured in Tiberias.
Physicians hesitated to prescribe medical cannabis, because with the usual methods there is no way to know how much of it the patient receives.
Syqe developed an inhaler that precisely turns small doses of the cannabis plant into an aerosol, with automatic thermal and flow controllers.
In a trial at Rambam Health Care Campus in Haifa, after a single inhalation of 1.0 mg THC, pain fell at its peak by an average of 39.42%.
According to Walla, the inhaler is approved for use by the Israeli Ministry of Health, and the company also received a medical device approval from the health authorities in Canada.

glance.label: Where
glance.value: Development in Jaffa, manufacturing in Tiberias

stations.title: Before: no one knew how much

paragraphs.text: According to a sponsored article on behalf of Syqe published on Ynet in January 2022, there were then close to 110 thousand medical cannabis license holders in Israel.
According to the same article, more than 80% of them consumed it by smoking or vaporizing flowers.
According to a research article, chronic pain affects approximately one in every five adults in developed countries.
According to the study, the usual ways of delivering cannabis provide unknown doses.
Therefore a standard pharmaceutical treatment plan cannot be implemented with them.
According to the Jerusalem Post, edibles, smoking and commercial inhalers also do not provide reliable or accurate doses.
According to the pilot study article, no available vaporizer device delivers precise and constant doses under standard pharmaceutical parameters.
According to Calcalist, without precise dosing it had not been possible until then to regard medical cannabis as a proper treatment.
Prof. Elon Eisenberg, later the principal investigator in the trial, said that the first thing that troubled physicians was smoking.
According to him, it is hard for physicians to recommend that patients smoke.
According to the study, smoking is not acceptable for therapeutic purposes, mainly because of the health risk from noxious pyrolytic products.
According to Eisenberg, research on cannabis also does not rise above a certain quality threshold, because it is not clear exactly what patients receive.

stations.title: The inhaler: a measured dose in every inhalation

paragraphs.text: According to Calcalist, Syqe Medical was founded in 2011.
Its development center is in Jaffa, and the inhaler and cartridges are manufactured in Tiberias.
The inhaler is designed to precisely turn multiple doses of granulated raw plant into an aerosol.
It has automatic thermal and flow controllers.
They ensure that the aerosol reaches the lungs, regardless of how the patient inhales.
The cannabis comes in a cartridge containing preloaded compressed doses.
The sources describe differently how many doses the cartridge holds and how much cannabis is in each dose.

According to Behadrei Haredim, these problems led Eisenberg to cooperate with Syqe and in 2014 bring the device into a first trial in the pain department at Rambam, which checked whether the device was reliable.
The randomized trial was conducted at the Pain Research Unit of Rambam Health Care Campus in Haifa.
Participants were required to hold a license from the Ministry of Health.
27 patients were found eligible for the trial.
At each visit the patient received a single inhalation: 0.5 mg THC, 1.0 mg THC or placebo, in random order.
At the 0.5 mg dose, pain fell at its peak by an average of 1.95 points, which is 24.97%.
At the 1.0 mg dose it fell by 2.95 points, which is 39.42%.
The reduction at the 1.0 mg dose was significantly larger than with placebo and than at the 0.5 mg dose.
When the dose was doubled, the peak THC level in the blood rose on average from 14.3 to 33.8 ng/ml.
No evidence of consistent cognitive impairment was found at the doses studied.
The researchers write that to the best of their knowledge, this is the first time that single, low, precise doses of inhaled THC have shown an analgesic effect.
According to a sponsored article on behalf of Syqe on Ynet, the inhaler is the product of clinical studies conducted at Rambam.

stations.title: In the wards and at home

paragraphs.text: In a further pilot study, inpatients at Rambam in Haifa who held a medical cannabis license from the Ministry of Health were recruited.
All participants easily learned to use the inhaler, and no device malfunctions were noted.
All participants reported a reduction in pain, and in 6 of 12 the pain fell by 20% or more.
According to the study, patients and staff were highly satisfied, and there were no complications.
In a longer follow-up study, by October 2020, 215 patients had enrolled and begun treatment with the inhaler.
Among 138 patients with chronic pain, pain intensity fell by 1.62 points.
Of 43 patients who used opioids at the start of treatment, 25 reported that they had reduced their dose after 120 days.
Among those who rated their quality of life, 59% reported improvement and 33% great improvement.
9% reported no change.
In this study, side effects were less common with the inhaler than with other routes of administration.
For comparison, according to the article, in mid-2021 a patient in Israel was prescribed an average of about 30 grams of cannabis per month.
According to the pilot study article, a home version of the inhaler was approved by the Ministry of Health and is in use in Israel.
In November 2016 it was reported that Teva Israel would be the exclusive marketer and distributor of the inhaler in Israel.
According to Walla, when Super-Pharm began selling the inhaler in 2021, buyers at the chain were entitled to a 300-shekel discount, after which its price was 1,650 shekels.
In April 2021 Syqe received a combined medical device approval from the health authorities in Canada.
According to Syqe's announcement, published in Calcalist, this is the first approval given by an international regulator to market a metered cannabis inhaler as a medical product.
Roni Goldenberg, a patient, said that before cannabis she consumed opiates at the highest level, until she had to stop.
According to her, the device's precision helps her use cannabis in a controlled way and reduce the psychoactive effect.
Hadas Avshalom said that she was the first patient to fly with the inhaler, and that she could use it anywhere without hiding.
According to her, with the inhaler she consumed only three doses a day and felt vital.
Syqe's CEO, Perry Davidson, said that if patients are treated with greater precision, less drug is needed and fewer side effects are expected.
Prof. Eisenberg said that it can be concluded from the study that low doses of cannabis may provide the desired effect without impairing cognition.
Some of the authors of the Rambam trial are Syqe employees, and others received research support from it.
In the follow-up study, two of the authors are employed by Syqe, and Eisenberg is employed by it as an external consultant.
The inpatient study was funded by Syqe, which developed the inhaler and holds its intellectual property.
The Rambam trial was not registered on ClinicalTrials.gov, due to an administrative error.
The researchers write that they did not ask patients which treatment they thought they had received, so it cannot be certain that blinding was complete.
The inpatient study was conducted without placebo, and its authors write that its results should be interpreted with caution.
In the follow-up study the sample was relatively small, and 28 patients, or 19.5%, dropped out.
17% of patients reported that pain did not decrease and 7% that it worsened, but they chose to continue with the inhaler.
In the Rambam trial, 95% of side effects were mild, and 80% were considered related to the study treatment.
At the 1.0 mg dose, heart rate rose significantly 15 minutes after inhalation.
In the inpatient study, three participants coughed mildly immediately after inhalation, and the cough resolved on its own within a minute.

disagreements.question: How much cannabis is in each dose?

versions.says: Inpatient study: 16.0 ± 0.5 mg of granulated cannabis flowers
Long-term follow-up study: 13.5 ± 0.9 mg of pharmaceutical-grade cannabis flowers

disagreements.question: How many doses are in the cartridge?
What is the best dose for pain?

versions.says: According to a statement by OurCrowd: just 500 micrograms of THC
According to the trial article: at the 1.0 mg dose pain fell significantly more than at the 0.5 mg dose

disagreements.question: By how much were side effects reduced compared with other methods?

versions.says: Follow-up study: 41% vs 76%, a reduction of 35%
Dr. Eitan Hai-Am, Syqe chairman: a reduction of about 90% according to data from patients in Israel

unknowns.text: According to Calcalist, in 2016 Syqe's licensing agreement with Philip Morris did not concern its cannabis activity; in July 2023 Calcalist reported that Philip Morris is acquiring Syqe in a deal that could reach $650 million.

claims.quote: אישור זה מצטרף לתו תקן רגולטורי אירופאי (CE), שהתקבל לפני מספר חודשים

claims.text: לפי כלכליסט, האישור בקנדה הוא הראשון שניתן על ידי רגולטור בינלאומי לשיווק משאף קנאביס מדיד כמוצר רפואי.
claims.quote: זהו האישור הראשון שניתן על ידי רשות רגולטורית בינלאומית לשיווק משאף קנאביס מדיד כמוצר רפואי

claims.text: רוני גולדנברג, מטופלת, סיפרה שלפני הקנאביס צרכה אופיאטים ברמה הגבוהה ביותר ושהגיעה לשלב שבו הייתה חייבת לעצור.
claims.quote: לפני הקנאביס צרכתי אופיאטים ברמה הכי גבוהה שיש. הגיע שלב שהייתי חייבת לעצור

claims.text: רוני גולדנברג סיפרה שדיוק המכשיר גורם לה להשתמש בקנאביס בצורה מבוקרת ולהפחית את ההשפעה הפסיכואקטיבית.
claims.quote: רמת הדיוק של המכשיר גורמת לי להשתמש בצורה מבוקרת בקנאביס ובכך בעצם, להפחית את ההשפעה הפסיכואקטיבית

claims.text: הדס אבשלום סיפרה שהפכה לחולה הראשונה שטסה עם המשאף ויכלה להשתמש בו בכל מקום בלי להסתתר.
claims.quote: והפכתי לחולה הראשונה שטסה עם המכשיר ויכולתי להשתמש בו בכל מקום בלי שאני אצטרך להסתתר

claims.text: הדס אבשלום סיפרה שעם המשאף צרכה רק שלוש מנות ביום והרגישה חיונית.
claims.quote: עם המכשיר, זה אחרת. קודם כול, צרכתי רק שלוש מנות ביום והרגשתי חיונית

claims.text: מנכ"ל סייקי מדיקל פרי דוידסון אמר שאם אפשר לטפל במטופלים בדיוק גבוה יותר, יידרשו כמויות תרופה קטנות יותר וצפויות פחות תופעות לוואי.
claims.quote: if we can treat patients with much higher precision, lower quantities of drug will be needed, resulting in fewer side effects and an overall more effective treatment

claims.text: חלק ממחברי המחקר הם עובדי סייקי מדיקל, ואחרים קיבלו ממנה תמיכה במחקר.
claims.quote: Dr. Hayon, Mrs. Ogintz, Mrs. Abalia, and Mr. Lupo are employees of Syqe Medical; Dr. Vulfsons and Prof. Eisenberg received research support from Syqe Medical.

claims.text: שניים ממחברי מחקר המעקב מועסקים בסייקי מדיקל, ואייזנברג מועסק בה כיועץ חיצוני.
claims.quote: J. Aviram and D. Atzmony are employed by Syqe Medical LTD. E. Eisenberg is employed by Syqe Medical Ltd as an external consultant.

claims.text: מחקר האשפוז מומן על ידי סייקי מדיקל, שפיתחה את המשאף ומחזיקה בקניינו הרוחני.
claims.quote: Funding to conduct this study was provided by Syqe Medical Ltd., which developed the Syqe Inhaler device and holds its intellectual property.

claims.text: המחקר לא נרשם באתר ClinicalTrials.gov של ה-NIH בגלל טעות אדמיניסטרטיבית.
claims.quote: Due to an administrative error, the study was not registered at the NIH ClinicalTrail.gov website.

claims.text: החוקרים מציינים כמגבלה שלא נשאלו המטופלים איזה טיפול לדעתם קיבלו, ולכן אי אפשר להיות בטוחים שהעיוורון היה מלא.
claims.quote: Fourth, patients were not asked at the end of each session what treatment they felt they had received, so we cannot be sure that patients were fully blinded to treatment arms.

claims.text: מחבריו מציינים שמחקר האשפוז היה ללא פלצבו ולכן יש לפרש את תוצאותיו בזהירות.
claims.quote: because no placebo was provided, results should be interpreted with caution

claims.text: החוקרים מציינים שהמדגם במחקר ארוך הטווח קטן יחסית ושהיה נשירה של 19.5%.
claims.quote: First, the sample is relatively small. Second, because of the ongoing nature of the study design and the 19.5% attrition rate

claims.text: במהלך המעקב נשרו 28 מטופלים (19.5%) מתוכנית התמיכה.
claims.quote: 28 patients (19.5%) dropped out from the PSP for the following reasons

claims.text: במחקר ארוך הטווח, 17% מהמטופלים דיווחו על אי ירידה בכאב ו-7% על החמרתו, אך בחרו להמשיך להשתמש במשאף.
claims.quote: Although 17% of the patients in the current study reported no decrease in pain intensity at the end of the titration phase and 7% reported worsening of pain, these patients elected to continue using the inhaler.

claims.text: רוב תופעות הלוואי (95%) סווגו כקלות, ו-80% נחשבו קשורות להתערבות המחקרית.
claims.quote: Most of the AEs were classified as mild (95%) and were considered related to the study intervention (80%).

claims.text: במינון 1.0 מ"ג נמצאה עלייה מובהקת בדופק 15 דקות אחרי השאיפה.
claims.quote: However, a significant increase in heart rate was noticed in the 1.0 mg dose 15 min following inhalation

claims.text: שלושה משתתפים דיווחו על שיעול קל מיד לאחר השאיפה, שחלף מעצמו בתוך דקה.
claims.quote: Three participants reported a mild cough immediately following inhalation, which resolved spontaneously within a minute.

claims.text: לפי הצהרה של פלטפורמת ההשקעות OurCrowd, המחקר מראה שהמינון היעיל האופטימלי להקלת כאב הוא 500 מיקרוגרם THC בלבד.
claims.quote: The study shows that an optimally effective dose to relieve pain is just 500 micrograms of THC.

claims.text: ד"ר איתן חי-עם, יו"ר סייקי, אמר שנתוני המטופלים בישראל מראים הפחתה של כ-90% בתופעות הלוואי בהשוואה לדרכי שימוש אחרות.
claims.quote: נתוני האמת של המטופלים בישראל מראים הפחתה של כ-90% מתופעות הלוואי בהשוואה לתצורות שימוש אחרות

claims.text: לפי הודעת סאיקי, שפורסמה בכלכליסט, זה האישור הראשון שנתן רגולטור בינלאומי לשיווק משאף קנאביס מדיד כמוצר רפואי.

quote_translations.c11: Syqe is an Israeli company, whose development center is located in Jaffa and the manufacturing of the inhaler and cartridges is done in Tiberias.
quote_translations.c72: The inhaler is approved for use by the Ministry of Health in Israel
quote_translations.c12: Israel's Syqe Medical received a combined Medical Device License (MDL) approval from the Canadian health authorities
quote_translations.c13: Syqe Medical was founded in 2011, the company's research and development center is located in Jaffa
quote_translations.c10: Today, there are close to 110 thousand medical cannabis license holders in Israel, more than 80% of them consume it through flowers by smoking or vaporizing.
quote_translations.c4: In the absence of precise dosing, it has not been possible until now to regard medical cannabis as a proper treatment
quote_translations.c6: The first thing that troubled us is that people take cannabis in the form of smoking. As physicians, it is hard for us to recommend that patients smoke
quote_translations.c7: The studies we have on cannabis do not manage to rise above a certain quality threshold, simply because we are not sure what people are receiving
quote_translations.c16: 15 milligrams of remarkably compressed cannabis trapped between two dense meshes
quote_translations.c39: It contains 75 doses arranged side by side on small platforms
quote_translations.c71: These reasons led Eisenberg to cooperate with Syqe and bring the device into a trial in the pain department
quote_translations.c73: Syqe's medical inhaler is the product of clinical studies conducted at the medical center
quote_translations.c60: Teva Israel will be the exclusive marketer and distributor in Israel of the Syqe inhaler for administering medical cannabis
quote_translations.c61: Patients who purchase the inhaler and cartridges at the chain's branches will be entitled to a discount on the inhaler of 300 shekels and its price will stand at a sum of 1,650 shekels
quote_translations.c58: This approval joins a European regulatory standard mark (CE), which was received a few months ago
quote_translations.c59: This is the first approval given by an international regulatory authority to market a metered cannabis inhaler as a medical product
quote_translations.c62: Before cannabis I consumed opiates at the highest level there is. There came a point when I had to stop
quote_translations.c63: The device's level of precision makes me use cannabis in a controlled way and thereby, in fact, reduce the psychoactive effect
quote_translations.c64: And I became the first patient to fly with the device and I could use it anywhere without having to hide
quote_translations.c65: With the device, it's different. First of all, I consumed only three doses a day and felt vital
quote_translations.c48: Real-world data of patients in Israel show a reduction of about 90% in side effects compared with other forms of use
quote_translations.c66: The agreement with the Philip Morris company does not concern the activity of the Syqe Medical company in the cannabis field
